name: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!
summary: Illiyana searches Ashenvale for her sisters, missing after setting out to recover a stolen relic. She asks travelers to find them in the corrupted ruins of Xavian.

sections.title: A Desperate Sister
sections.body: Dryad Illiyana waits in Ashenvale, overwhelmed with worry for her sisters. They left for the corrupted northern reaches of the forest to recover the Branch of Cenarius, a holy relic stolen by satyrs. They promised to return swiftly, but two days have passed without word. Now Illiyana asks passing Alliance travelers to track them down before it is too late.

sections.title: The Ruins of Xavian
sections.body: Xavian lies to the northeast, an ancient night elf temple complex long corrupted by the Burning Legion. Fel-tainted satyrs swarm its ruins, making them a perilous place to search. Deep inside, Anilia, leader of the dryad expedition, lies gravely wounded and near death after the demonic inhabitants attacked her.

aliases: who gives vile satyr dryads in danger
faq.answer: Illiyana is a dryad who lives in the forests of Ashenvale. Worried for her sisters, she sends travelers toward Xavian to search for their missing party.

faq.q: What is the Branch of Cenarius?
aliases: what relic were they looking for
faq.answer: The Branch of Cenarius is a sacred relic precious to dryads and night elves. Satyrs in northern Ashenvale stole it, and Anilia and her sisters set out on a dangerous journey into Xavian to recover it.
Xavian is an ancient night elf temple in eastern Ashenvale. Demonic satyrs have overrun the ruins, where fel corruption threatens nature's protectors.
Anilia is the dryad who led the search party to reclaim the Branch of Cenarius from the satyrs. Illiyana asks travelers to find her in Xavian.

faq.q: Why are the dryads in conflict with the satyr?
faq.answer: Dryads are daughters of the demigod Cenarius, devoted to preserving nature and the forest's balance. Satyrs are ancient night elves twisted by demonic fel magic, and they corrupt the wilderness and desecrate sacred groves.
Finding Anilia completes the search and leads into 'The Branch of Cenarius', where the effort to recover the stolen relic continues.

angles.text: As a night elf, you share a bond with the dryads, daughters of Cenarius. Their distress and the defilement of ancient elven temples in Xavian call on your honor and spiritual duty.
As a druid, you share a deep kinship with the children of Cenarius. You are sworn to cleanse the demonic corruption spreading from satyr strongholds like Xavian.
As an Alliance traveler, you strengthen the Alliance's bond with Ashenvale's mystical denizens when you help Illiyana amid growing regional threats.
